name: Kex Template (HTML)
_comment: The HTML host of a .ket template (kexhq/kex#314). `source.ket` alone leaves everything outside a tag unscoped, because the host language is only knowable from the extension in front of .ket — so `foo.html.ket` gets this grammar instead: the same tag rules over `text.html.basic`. The tags are an L-injection rather than a leading entry in `patterns` because top-level order only settles ties at the same position: once the host has begun a multi-token region of its own (an attribute value, a tag's insides) its patterns are the only ones consulted, and `<a href="<%= url %>">` would lose its tag. `L:` puts these ahead of the host's rules at every position instead. Shaped after `text.html.erb`; the Markdown twin is ket-markdown.tmLanguage.json.
